design_description: A minimalist heritage-inspired design that embraces simplicity through clean lines and subtle tonal contrast. The crisp white base is complemented by a soft vertical center panel in a slightly lighter shade, adding understated depth without distracting from the overall look. Royal blue double-ring trim on the collar and sleeve cuffs provides a fresh, classic accent that frames the jersey elegantly. The uncluttered composition keeps the focus on the crest and logos, creating a balanced and timeless football aesthetic. Overall, the jersey feels clean, elegant, and traditional, proving that restrained detailing can deliver a refined and modern identity.
